facts.fact: Raxio's data sheet says the ET1 data centre in Addis Ababa takes a 33kV utility supply directly fed from the nearest substation, with 2N power redundancy and 72 hours of on-site fuel.
Raxio's data sheet states a PUE of 1.3 for the ET1 data centre, with indirect adiabatic cooling.

ETH.note: No water use figure is stated.

facts.fact: Raxio's data sheet describes ET1 in Addis Ababa's ICT Park as a carrier-neutral colocation data centre holding an Uptime Institute Tier III TCCD certification.

ETH.note: The sheet says only that ET1 is to host Ethiopia's IXP; no exchange in service is stated.
Document says nothing about a national ID system.
Document says nothing about government technical staff.
The sheet gives no ownership of the Ethiopian facility; it names only Raxio's Amsterdam headquarters.
Document names no government backup site.
